source: Starting point, not official. Mesa Mark IIC+ high gain, scooped mids (tonemirror: gain 8, bass 6, mid 4, treble 6, presence 7; rigtone: gain 8, bass 4, mid 2, treble 9). 'Key element': a graphic EQ in the amp loop with a V curve — rigtone: 80 Hz up, 750 Hz deep cut, 2.2 kHz and 6.6 kHz up (mixdownmag: Boss GE-7 V-curve). BG MARK3 + Gt GEQ 7 rebuild that chain. Low-gain TS as a tightening boost. Little solo delay; tap tempo.
